title: We asked a user to play test our Battlerite remake...and it's safe to say they loved it.
author: cointalkz
selftext:
Battlerite is still playable, but it's been in maintenance mode for years and the players drifted away. So we rebuilt it in the browser and called it Battle-Right.

  
We had a user play test it before we launched to see if it was fun and bugs were fixed....safe to say they loved it. Give it a try and let me know what you think! I am absolutely hooked.

  
[https://www.spawn.co/@sleepy/battle-right](https://www.spawn.co/@sleepy/battle-right)

  
It was built completely free on Spawn in a few days, multiplayer wired in from the start. If you have any suggestions or improvements let us know! Otherwise, hope you enjoy it as much as our friend in the video lol
